title: Degreewise finite free stalk-map extension
statement:
Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and P,Q cochain complexes of O_Y-modules
[def-pc-derived-category] supported in integer intervals [a,b] and [c,e]. Assume
every term is zero or isomorphic to a finite free sheaf [def-weil-pbc-free-module].
Let y be a point of Y, T the termwise pullback along Y.fromSpecStalk y
[def-pc-derived-pullback], and t_n:T(P)^n -> T(Q)^n any degreewise family, with no
chain-equation assumption. There are an open U containing y and maps
g_n:R_U(P)^n -> R_U(Q)^n such that S_U(g_n)=E_U(P).hom_n ; t_n ; E_U(Q).inv_n
for every n, where R_U is open restriction, S_U is pullback along the stalk map
into U, and E_U is the comparison [def-pc-stalk-restriction-complex-iso]. No
commutativity with differentials is concluded.

proof.text: Apply the degreewise local representation theorem, which needs only the finite-free hypotheses. Apply the common-neighbourhood theorem to this result and the bounded-support hypotheses. Choose a representative in each degree on this common neighbourhood and use its component equation. This choice occurs only inside a proposition proof, not in a data definition.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_degreewise_of_stalk_local
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (P Q : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ)
    (a b c e : ℤ)
    (hPa : P.IsStrictlyGE a) (hPb : P.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hQc : Q.IsStrictlyGE c) (hQe : Q.IsStrictlyLE e)
    (hPfree : ∀ n : ℤ, IsZero (P.X n) ∨ ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (hQfree : ∀ n : ℤ, IsZero (Q.X n) ∨ ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (Q.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (y : Y)
    (t : ∀ n : ℤ,
      (((Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P).X n ⟶
      (((Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj Q).X n) :
    ∃ (U : Y.Opens), ∃ (hyU : y ∈ U), ∃ (g : ∀ n : ℤ,
      (((restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P).X n ⟶
      (((restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q).X n),
      ∀ n : ℤ, (Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)).map (g n) =
        ((stalkRestrictionComplexIso U y hyU).app P).hom.f n ≫ t n ≫
          ((stalkRestrictionComplexIso U y hyU).app Q).inv.f n
